author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಕತ್ತಲಲೆ ನವಮಾಸ ಕಳೆಯುತಲೆ ಮಾನವನೆ
ಬತ್ತದಿಹ ಬೆಳಕನ್ನು ಪಡೆಯುವೆಯೊ ನೀನು
ಚಿತ್ತದಲಿ ಸದ್ಗುಣದ ದೀಪಸ್ತಂಭವ ನಿಲಿಸಿ
ಬಿತ್ತುನೀ ಬೆಳಕನ್ನೆ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: Nine months you spent in darkness, O man,
and then received a light that never runs dry;
set up a lamp-post of virtue in your mind,
and sow that light in turn, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: We come out of the darkness of the womb into a light we did not earn. The fitting return is to raise a steady lamp of good qualities within and spread its light to others.
